title: Lockheed Martin VP tried to bring the craft out into the open

tellings.quote: That's why you had the vice president of Lockheed Martin trying to get the craft and hardware that they have obtained a long time ago out the back door

plain: Around 2008 to 2010, a vice president of Lockheed Martin, the large US defence company, is said to have tried to move craft and hardware the company obtained long ago "out the back door", meaning out of secret hands and into the open. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells this, repeating what he says he learned from people involved in a government-funded study of the subject. If true, it would mean a major defence contractor holds unknown craft.
